notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Forests.
description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Rofellos.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Rofellos.
Repeat.
